script_name: HTTP 请求伪造随机 IP
content:
headers = <<<HEAD
X-Forwarded-For
X-Forwarded
Forwarded-For
Forwarded
X-Requested-With
X-Forwarded-Proto
X-Forwarded-Host
X-remote-IP
X-remote-addr
True-Client-IP
X-Client-IP
Client-IP
X-Real-IP
Ali-CDN-Real-IP
Cdn-Src-Ip
Cdn-Real-Ip
CF-Connecting-IP
X-Cluster-Client-IP
WL-Proxy-Client-IP
Proxy-Client-IP
Fastly-Client-Ip
True-Client-Ip
X-Originating-IP
X-Host
X-Original-Host
X-Original-IP
Via
X-Via
X-Custom-IP-Authorization

HEAD


handle = func(req) {
    target = x`{{ri(1,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}.{{ri(0,255)}}`[0]
    for i in headers.Split("\n") {
        i = str.TrimSpace(i)
        if i == "" {
            continue
        }
        req = poc.ReplaceHTTPPacketHeader(req, i, target)
    }
    return string(req)
}
help: HTTP 请求伪造随机 IP
